mapper.insert: INSERT INTO orders (order_date, customer_name, status) VALUES (#{orderDate}, #{customerName}, #{status})
INSERT INTO order_items (order_id, item_id, quantity) VALUES (#{orderId}, #{itemId}, #{quantity})
mapper.select: SELECT id AS id, order_date AS orderDate, customer_name AS customerName, status AS status, created_at AS createdAt FROM orders WHERE id = #{id}

SELECT oi.id AS id, oi.item_id AS itemId, i.name AS itemName, i.sales_unit AS salesUnit, oi.quantity AS quantity, oi.shipped_quantity AS shippedQuantity FROM order_items oi JOIN items i ON i.id = oi.item_id WHERE oi.order_id = #{orderId}
